description.blurb: S/2006 S 10 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2006 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2006 S 10 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 19.0 million km in 983.14 days. It has an inclination of 161.6° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.151.
